title: Portrait and Choir
author: A. M. Blackwood
blurb: Xanthe Zhou, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
